announcement.title: Your websites and internal tools, together in Apps
announcement.description: Save a website or dashboard as an app with its own persistent login and browser controls. Connected agents can read enabled apps and follow links without repeated access prompts; edits still require approval. Share app definitions across your organisation while everyone keeps their own login. Create app now also offers an internal app option that prepares an editable request in your chat. Local app updates refresh imported UI files, and unavailable share links show a clearer error.
